subject: Next steps — ownership map, security checklist & champion enablement
messages:
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Leah Moreno <leah@averytech.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 21 Jul 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps — ownership map, security checklist & champion enablement

Hi Leah — great call this morning, thanks for carving out the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

Call highlights:
- Primary driver: reduce inference cost and latency for customer-facing workflows (aiming for 40% token-cost reduction across peak flows).
- Champion: you and your ML Platform lead (you mentioned Priya could be a secondary champion).
- Economic buyer: Head of Payments (Raj Patel) — will need a succinct ROI case.
- Security/legal gate: InfoSec questionnaire + sample architecture diagram required. Procurement wants SOW redlines and standard T&Cs.

Immediate asks / proposed owners:
1) Ownership map (who owns each gate): I can draft a one-page ownership map for review — target due Wed 07/24. (owner: Sean)
2) Security evidence: we’ll attach the standard checklist and a short artifact pack (SOC 2 excerpt, data flow diagram, retention policy). Please share InfoSec contact and any specific controls they’ll test. (owner: Avery / InfoSec)
3) ROI snapshot for Raj: 2-slide economic summary + 6-month projection with conservative usage assumptions. I’ll put together a draft and share by Tue 07/24. (owner: Sean/Karthik)
4) Procurement path: Leah — can you introduce procurement@averytech.com so we can align on contract timing and PO requirements? (owner: Leah)

Champion enablement items I’m prepping (will send as separate attachments):
- 3 bullet 'quick wins' talk tracks your champions can use in a 10-minute exec briefing
- A one-page ROI summary for Raj focusing on cost delta and expected payback
- A short tech note for Priya on integration steps and demo snippets for their platform engineers

Attachments: Avery-MAP-v1.pptx (ownership map draft), security-evidence-checklist.pdf (placeholder file list).

Proposed next meeting: 30-minute sync w/ InfoSec + Procurement — options Tue 07/24 10:00-10:30 or Wed 07/25 14:00-14:30 PT. Which works for you?

Thanks — Sean
--
Sean Gallagher | Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
sean.gallagher@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

Leah / Priya / Procurement team — thanks for confirming. Calendar invite sent for Tue 07/24 10:00 PT. See attached two succinct packets we discussed: 

1) Avery-MAP-v1.pptx — ownership map + 1-slide champion talk track (talk tracks inside slide 4).
2) security-evidence-checklist.pdf — index of artifacts we can provide immediately (SOC 2 excerpt, retention policy, sample network diagram, penetration test summary).

A couple of quick items for Priya: 
- If you have a short list of specific controls (e.g., encryption-at-rest, key management, data segregation), reply-all and I’ll mark those items high priority in the artifact pack.
- For integration: Redwood supports both API-based tokenized uploads and VPC connectors. Monica has compiled a 5-step integration snippet we can share with Priya and Priya's infra team during the sync.

Champion enablement (for Leah / Priya / Priya's team): 
- Exec talk track (for Raj): cost delta + 6-month payback; keep to two slides, include baseline vs. Redwood expected cost under average and peak.
- Tech talk (for Priya): minimal infra changes, sample curl/SDK snippet, and latency profile for their expected sequence length (we'll include numbers in follow-up).

Next steps checklist (owners):
- Send ROI snapshot to Raj by EOD Tue 07/24 (Sean & Karthik)
- InfoSec list confirmation and artifact delivery (Sean & Monica — target Wed 07/25)
- Procurement SOW draft + pricing line items (Sean — will circulate initial draft Wed 07/25)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Jul 2028 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Next steps — ownership map, security checklist & champion enablement

Sean / Monica — adding a brief internal note before we send the ROI deck to Raj. Draft guidance for the 2-slide ROI snapshot (I built the numbers against the usage profile Leah shared):

- Slide 1 (Executive): 3 bullets: problem statement, expected savings (conservative: 28% token-unit cost reduction), and payback (6–8 months). Add one line on mitigations: fallback model variants for peak traffic.
- Slide 2 (Assumptions & math): baseline monthly tokens (450M), Redwood projected tokens (same traffic; unit cost reduction assumptions), sample monthly cost table (baseline vs Redwood), and a callout for intangible benefits (improved tail latency -> fewer user complaints).

Champion talk-track bullets (for Leah / Priya to use with Raj):
- "We can lower inference spend while keeping or improving latency for our customer-facing flows; Redwood has a production runtime that supports sticky KV cache and quantization profiles to cut token costs."
- "Pilot can run against a low-risk subset (search suggestions) for 30 days; measurable cost and latency KPIs, minimal infra changes."
- "Procurement will be asked for a standard SOW + one-time enablement fee — we’ll get a draft ready so you can share with Raj."
Send me the draft deck before you send to Raj and I’ll do a quick read.

—Karthik
Head of Solutions, Redwood Inference
